description: This Java class is a builder for constructing instances of EncounterSearchCriteria by setting various search parameters related to medical encounters, such as patient, location, dates, encounter types, providers, visit types, and whether to include voided encounters.

classes.name: EncounterSearchCriteriaBuilder
classes.description: A builder class to facilitate the construction of EncounterSearchCriteria objects by setting various search parameters related to medical encounters.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient for whom to search encounters; returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location where the encounter took place; returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the minimum date (inclusive) of encounters to filter; returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the maximum date (exclusive) of encounters to filter; returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the minimum date that the encounter was changed; returns the builder instance for chaining.

methods.name: setEnteredViaForms
methods.description: Sets the collection of forms that entered the encounter; omitted if null or empty; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: setEncounterTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of encounter types to filter; omitted if null or empty; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: setProviders
methods.description: Sets the collection of providers involved in the encounter; omitted if null or empty; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: setVisitTypes
methods.description: Sets the collection of visit types for the encounter; omitted if null or empty; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: setVisits
methods.description: Sets the collection of visits for the encounter; omitted if null or empty; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: setIncludeVoided
methods.description: Specifies whether to include voided (deleted or voided) encounters; returns the builder instance.

methods.name: createEncounterSearchCriteria
methods.description: Constructs and returns an EncounterSearchCriteria object with the set parameters.
